subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Great to hear more about Aurelia Tech's timeline and priorities. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) capturing the milestones we discussed, owners, and target dates. High level items we captured for the next 8 weeks:

- Discovery/POC sign-off (Aurelia) — target: 2026-07-30 — dependency: access to sample dataset
- Security review & SOC 2 package delivery (Redwood) — target: 2026-08-05 (evidence list) / 2026-08-12 (full package) — owner: Redwood security (cc'd Dev)
- Procurement/PO review (Aurelia) — target: 2026-08-18 — dependency: SOC2 package + final SOW
- Pilot kickoff (joint) — target: 2026-08-25
- Target close (contract signed) — target: 2026-09-15

Action items for you today: please confirm the security reviewer contact (name + email) and any additional compliance evidence your team will specifically request beyond a typical SOC 2 bundle.

Attachments: Aurelia_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), redwood_soc2-questionnaire.pdf (SOC 2 checklist), redwood_evidence-list.csv (artifact list).

If these targets look reasonable we'll update the MAP and circulate a clean version for signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference runtime
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurelia-tech.com>, Procurement <procurement@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear MAP, this is helpful. Our security reviewer will be Tom Alvarez (tom.alvarez@aurelia-tech.com) — he'll lead the review and coordinate evidence requests. Quick notes from our side:

- We typically want access to network diagrams + data flow, encryption-at-rest and in-transit details, retention & deletion policies, and a sample of your SOC 2 report and evidence index.
- Can you confirm whether Redwood provides a consolidated evidence bundle (e.g., a zip with artifacts) or if we should expect links to separate evidence items?
- Procurement looped in — they want the SOC 2 package before finalizing payment terms.

Tom, looping you for visibility.

Regards,
Samantha
VP Product | Aurelia Tech
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-17T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Hi Samantha and team —

Thanks Samantha, great to meet you (virtually). Quick answers to your questions:

- We will provide a consolidated SOC 2 package (PDF SOC 2 report + evidence bundle) delivered as a secure zip via a private Drive link. Evidence items include (non-exhaustive): network diagrams, architecture whitepaper, encryption config excerpts, sample audit logs, access-control matrices, third-party vendor attestations, and retention/deletion policy excerpts.
- Estimated delivery: evidence list (CSV) by 2026-08-05; full package (redwood_soc2-package.zip with report + evidence pointers) by 2026-08-12. If you need a live walkthrough, we can schedule a 30–45 minute session with our security team the week of 2026-08-10.

I've attached the SOC 2 questionnaire and the evidence index for your review. If anything on the list looks missing for your requirements, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: 2026-07-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Thanks Dev — that's exactly the level we need. Two quick asks from my side:

1) Can you include sample redactable audit logs showing request IDs and anonymized entries?
2) Please provide the encryption key management section (KMS/HSM vendor, rotation policy).

If you can add those to the evidence list, procurement will be comfortable moving forward with payment terms. Also happy to take the walkthrough; 2026-08-11 or 2026-08-12 works for me.

Subject: Re: MAP draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - next steps

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround and the specifics, Tom. Per the asks above we've updated the MAP to add the two security sub-items (redacted audit logs sample + KMS/HSM section) and set firm delivery dates:

- SOC 2 evidence list (CSV) — owner: Redwood (Dev) — due: 2026-08-05
- SOC 2 full package (secure bundle + report) — owner: Redwood — due: 2026-08-12
- Security walkthrough (optional) — owner: Redwood — target: 2026-08-11 (tentative)
- Procurement review & payment terms — owner: Aurelia Procurement — target: 2026-08-18
- Target close (contract executed) — target: 2026-09-15

Next steps (actionable):
1) Dev to deliver evidence list by 2026-08-05 (Dev: confirm CSV + any redaction notes).
2) Tom to confirm the walkthrough slot (2026-08-11 or 2026-08-12).
3) Marissa to circulate updated MAP v1.1 after Dev confirms the evidence list items.

I'll upload the updated MAP and a secure Drive link to the package once Dev confirms. Let me know if procurement needs anything else to unblock payment earlier.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
